<!-- Generated by tools/refgen from spin-terraform-aws:images.json. Edit the source, not this file. -->

Every machine of an installation boots Spin OS, built for one release of spin. The module reads the image of each machine from its `images.json`, by `spin_version` and region, so an installation of `v20261025.01` can be made in a region listed here and nowhere else. To boot images of your own, name them with `image_ids` and their measurements with `image_measurements` ([the module's variables](/reference/terraform/root/#image_ids)).

| Region | Control plane | Proxy | Runner |
|---|---|---|---|
| `us-east-1` | `ami-00cb2d0feffe89588` | `ami-0ac882e2869f704f9` | `ami-090fbe7203af7a8bd` |
| `us-west-2` | `ami-0ae9395569c631c81` | `ami-02b2c9c828e4db70d` | `ami-06f1c0680dcd7ea96` |
